Title: Industrial Engineer
Industries: Computer Hardware Manufacturing, Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing, and Semiconductor Manufacturing
Description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Job Description Join our DRAM Products and Architecture Group (DPAG) as an Industrial Engineer (IE) and help shape how we plan and complete future DRAM products. You will collaborate with global engineering, program management, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to solve complex problems and deliver significant business impact. In this role, you will develop DRAM module forecasts, cost strategies, and early product life-cycle demand models that support successful product development and driving execution, making sure that road blockers are eliminated. You will also innovate with AI-assisted tools, automation, and advanced analytics to improve Industrial Engineering models and workflows, increase efficiency, and enable faster, data-driven decisions. You will combine these technologies with engineering judgment and responsible AI practices while continuously learning and improving how we work. Responsibilities Build and enhance AI-assisted demand and forecasting models that translate product development needs into actionable plans, including long-term engineering demand, special product flows, and evolving requirements. Collaborate across global teams in Innovation, Technology, & Products (ITP), Global Supply Chain (GSC), Business Units, and Compute Customer Enablement (CCE) to align development requirements, laboratory priorities, build quantities, and execution plans. Drive efficiency and cost optimization by developing OpEx strategies, improving inventory and cycle time, identifying expenditure opportunities, and communicating forecasts, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and product teams. Provide experimental and execution support for Product Engineering development activities, including reflows, fuse sort, and business upside opportunities. Innovate with AI, automation, and data analytics to analyze complex datasets, strengthen decision-making, automate repeatable workflows, perform problem-solving and root-cause analysis, and improve the quality and speed of engineering execution. Develop and continuously improve product-development flows across development chips, New Product Introduction (NPI), and sustaining products, supporting engineering inventory health, qualification activities, experiments, documentation, and learning. Minimum Qualifications Proficiency in capacity planning, forecasting, data analysis, or related Industrial Engineering methods, with the ability to develop analytical models that support engineering or manufacturing decisions. Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex datasets, identify root causes, and develop practical recommendations. Strong interpersonal skills and collaboration, with the ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English and influence technical and business collaborators across a global organization. Ability to build and develop AI-assisted, automation, or advanced analytics solutions that improve efficiency, workflows, and data-driven decision-making, while applying appropriate human judgment and responsible AI practices. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize work, manage changing requirements, and drive impactful outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, and execution risk. Preferred Qualifications Experience with engineering demand planning, product forecasting, capacity planning, inventory optimization, or supply chain processes in a manufacturing or technology environment. Experience collaborating across product engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business organizations on complex product-development programs. Ability to craft clear, concise presentations and recommendations for technical teams, multi-functional partners, and senior leaders. Experience applying AI, automation, or advanced analytics to develop scalable engineering tools, streamline repetitive work, and improve business processes. A continuous-learning attitude with demonstrated interest in innovation, process improvement, and developing more efficient engineering methodologies. Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
Description: Job Title: Manager, Software Engineering Location : Guadalajara, MX - Remote Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System , enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won - the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue - and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing AI Platform team in the US, owning the design and build-out of our AI Context Layer - the data platform that gives our AI agents access to high-quality, well-governed context about the world they operate in. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer who can help realize the Salesloft vision with their passion and proven track record of excellence and innovation. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about their work and who thrive on leading-edge technologies to develop ground-breaking AI-driven enterprise-grade applications. On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to - Embed with feature teams across the organization to understand what they need from the context layer - what data, at what quality, in what form - and use those insights to drive the platform roadmap. Build the technical vision and roadmap for our Context Layer: a collection of high-quality data products - including a knowledge graph, RAG engines, and retrieval/search infrastructure - that give AI agents access to the best possible context about our customers and their revenue processes. Design and own the access control and RBAC model for the context layer - a genuinely hard problem at the intersection of multi-tenant data, agent identity, and fine-grained permissions. Define and evolve the APIs, SDKs, and developer interfaces that teams use to interact with the context layer, ensuring they are ergonomic, well-documented, and built for scale. Identify data platform dependencies and work closely with data engineering to ensure the underlying data infrastructure can reliably service the context layer's needs. Drive architecture discussions, design and code reviews, and set the technical standard for how context is modeled, stored, retrieved, and governed. Address governance and security requirements around data access, lineage, and auditability in an AI context. Contribute to hiring strong and diverse talent to strengthen the team. Contribute actively to internal documentation, onboarding, and platform adoption programs to ensure the Context Layer is well-understood and widely used. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our 'team over self' core value, you will also have the opportunity to work on impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer, AIPrincipal AI Engineer to lead the design and build-out of our Context Layer - the data platform that gives our AI agents access to high-quality, well-governed context about the world they operate in. This includes a knowledge graph, RAG and retrieval systems, and the access control and governance infrastructure that sits around them. You will be the technical owner and driver of this platform, working across feature teams and data engineering to build systems that are accurate, fast, secure, and a joy to build on. This role sits alongside talented staff engineers who own specific platform domains. The principal brings cross-cutting technical leadership, roadmap synthesis, and the ability to connect the dots across those domains . If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Principal AI Engineer is the career path for you! THE TEAM: The Engineering Team at Salesloft is deeply committed to building an enterprise-grade platform that serves as the backbone for our customers' most critical business process - Revenue. With an unrelenting commitment to innovation, our mission is to craft the ultimate revenue intelligence platform for our customers. Rooted in Agile principles, we foster a culture of adaptability and efficiency across all our teams. If you're energized by the prospect of contributing to a dynamic environment that emphasizes collaboration, continuous improvement, and leveraging the forefront of technology to address customer needs, we would love to meet you. THE SKILL SET: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on data-layer or search/retrieval infrastructure Proven experience designing and building knowledge graphs and/or large-scale retrieval and search systems in production Deep expertise in RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding-based retrieval - including evaluation, quality tuning, and relevance optimization Strong understanding of access control and RBAC design in multi-tenant, data-rich environments, with the judgment to navigate the tradeoffs involved Experience designing developer-facing APIs and SDKs, with a track record of building interfaces that are intuitive and well-adopted internally Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and audit-ability requirements - particularly in enterprise or regulated contexts Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction across multiple teams and drive complex, multi-stakeholder projects to delivery Experience with Python and/or Java; comfort working across data engineering, backend systems, and platform infrastructure Excellent communication skills - able to work across engineering, product, data, and leadership to align on direction and drive outcomes At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! Title: Senior Consultant - Manufacturing Operational
Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting and Business Consulting and Services
Description: About Cognizant Consulting Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice—we’re a global community of 5,000+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you? About The Role As a Senior Consultant – Process & Industrial Manufacturing , you will make an impact by helping manufacturing clients optimize production operations, improve quality and safety practices, and deliver measurable operational efficiency gains. You will be a valued member of the Manufacturing Consulting team and work collaboratively with engineering, operations, supply chain, quality management, project teams, and clients. In This Role, You Will Assess end-to-end process and industrial manufacturing operations to identify efficiency gaps, quality risks, safety concerns, and opportunities to improve productivity and cost effectiveness. Analyze production workflows, material flows, equipment utilization, and manufacturing performance data to reduce cycle times, minimize waste, and improve consistency of production outcomes. Partner with engineering, operations, supply chain, and quality stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into solution blueprints, process improvements, and implementation roadmaps. Lead working sessions and support implementation of operational excellence and digital enablement initiatives, defining milestones, expected benefits, performance indicators, process documentation, and control mechanisms. Monitor implemented solutions and performance metrics, identify opportunities for continuous improvement, and advise clients on process variability, equipment reliability, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and operational risk. Work model – Hybrid We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring a combination of onsite and remote collaboration. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you must have to be considered 4–6 years of hands-on consulting or industry experience in Process Manufacturing, with exposure to complex production environments such as chemical, pharmaceutical, or food manufacturing. Strong experience with Industrial Manufacturing operations, including assembly processes, heavy equipment utilization, and standardized production methods. Experience analyzing manufacturing workflows, material flows, equipment utilization, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including quantitative analysis and structured root-cause analysis. Knowledge of continuous improvement and operational excellence methodologies with the ability to develop practical and sustainable process improvements. Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into structured solution recommendations and implementation plans. Ability to develop process maps, standard operating procedures, analytical reports, and other manufacturing process documentation. Ability to work with manufacturing data, validate data integrity, and interpret operational performance dashboards. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with shop-floor personnel, engineers, operations teams, and business leaders. Ability to operate effectively in hybrid delivery environments through disciplined planning, collaboration, and coordination. These will help you succeed Experience supporting manufacturing transformation or digital enablement initiatives. Experience developing detailed implementation roadmaps with milestones, resource requirements, expected benefits, and measurable KPIs. Knowledge of manufacturing quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and operational risk practices. Experience supporting manufacturing systems and analytical tools used to monitor production performance. Experience with post-implementation performance monitoring, benefits realization, and continuous improvement. Understanding of sustainability-focused manufacturing practices, including energy optimization, waste reduction, and responsible resource consumption. Experience developing reusable consulting frameworks, templates, methodologies, or case studies. Strong client-facing consulting skills with the ability to facilitate workshops, challenge assumptions, and drive stakeholder alignment. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role

Description: LOCATION: ECoE Guadalajara (Global role) REPORTS TO: Sr Analyst Global Operations Finance We are looking for a Global Capex Analyst to support the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of Capex portfolio data across the organization. This role plays a critical operational function in maintaining the Portfolio Forecast file and ensuring reliable data inputs for monthly Capex reviews, KPI tracking, and executive decision-making. Positioned at the intersection of engineering, finance, and systems, the role ensures that portfolio-level data is consistently updated, reconciled, and aligned with actual project execution. By delivering accurate and timely updates, this position enables transparent performance tracking, forecast reliability, and improved Capex governance. Core Responsibilities Portfolio Data Management & Forecast Updates Maintain and update the Global Portfolio Forecast file, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of data. Consolidate monthly actuals spending from all segments, ensuring alignment with reported figures and resolving discrepancies. Ensure consistency between forecast, actuals, and approved project data. System Reporting & Data Integrity (PowerSteering) Extract and review daily reports from PowerSteering to track newly approved projects. Update and maintain the central Capex project database, ensuring alignment with system data. Perform data clean-up and validation activities in PowerSteering to improve data quality and usability Stakeholder Coordination & Monthly Review Support Interface with segment engineering and finance teams to ensure timely updates to Capex forecasts. Proactively follow up on missing, outdated, or inconsistent information ahead of monthly governance reviews. Support consolidation of inputs for monthly Capex review cycles. KPI Tracking & Performance Monitoring Maintain and update project approval dates and execution timelines to support tracking of Time KPIs. Ensure data completeness to enable accurate measurement of cycle time, approval lead time, and execution performance. Support analysis of portfolio trends by ensuring high-quality underlying data. Qualified Candidates Will Have Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Business, or related field. Typically 1–3 years of experience in financial analysis, data management, or project controls. Strong proficiency in Excel and data handling (required). Familiarity with PowerSteering, SAP, or similar systems is a plus. High attention to detail and strong focus on data accuracy and discipline. Ability to manage recurring processes, deadlines, and large data volumes. Effective communication skills to engage with cross-functional and regional stakeholders.
